note: Grant County, KS (seat and only city Ulysses). No queryable zoning district polygon service found. The City of Ulysses publishes its zoning as PDF documents (Article VI districts and boundaries PDF, zoning map PDF) and the county planning office has no GIS zoning layer. The KGIS statewide zoning map service covers Knox County and other cities, not Grant County. The only 'Grant County zoning' ArcGIS layer found (services2.arcgis.com/hQZvdtFxRzJpMtdS, Zoning/FeatureServer/0) is Grant County, Washington, so it was rejected.
